name: [XMAS🎄]Find the "Seasouls"!
desc:
🎃 SPOOKY SEASON IS HERE! Every few hours, the Canary Islands fall into a Halloween night and the Halloween Seasouls come out to play 👻
🕯️ New this year: a pumpkin lantern that reveals will-o’-the-wisps — follow their glow to 8 brand-new Seasouls hiding in the dark.
🦇 The 40 classic Halloween Seasouls return in costume. Find all 48 to unlock the FREE, limited Haunted Abyss Wings — event only!
🗓️ A new island unlocks every day. Grab your lantern and explore!

🌍 Do you know the Canary Islands? A volcanic archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean!
🐋 That's where the Seasouls live — magical sea creatures that have protected the islands for countless years. Can you find them all?
Find Seasouls on each island to unlock: 🎈 Balloon · 🚲 Bike · 🪂 Paraglider · 🪖 Diving Suit · 🏄🏻 Surfboard · 📡 Radar · 🤸🏻‍♀️ Double Jump
Constant updates! Hit "Like" and add the game to your favorites!
